What's new

Draft, proposed, Marc to confirm. Last updated 2026-10-26.

  • 2026-10-26The waiting list opens. Leave your email and we will tell you when the app is ready; we use it for nothing else.
  • 2026-10-25Terms and Help pages added, with a clear 30-day refund promise and answers for lost words and silent iPhones.
  • 2026-10-24Pages for the Year 1 and Year 2 spelling lists, each with a button to hear every word read aloud.
  • 2026-10-23Words and recordings now stay on your own device, so the app works offline and nothing about your children is uploaded.
  • 2026-10-22Export and import: save your words and recordings to a file and restore them on another device.
  • 2026-10-20Fixed the dictation stopping after the first word, and recordings no longer clip the start of words like "spoil".
